sentences.text: Today we will talk about Suriname.
Suriname is a small, green and diverse country in South America.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Suriname?
Suriname is in northern South America.
It is next to Guyana, Brazil, and French Guyana.
It touches the Atlantic Ocean in the north.
Most of Suriname is covered by rainforest.
What is the capital city of Suriname?
The capital city is Paramaribo.
Paramaribo is on the coast near the Suriname River.
It has colorful wooden houses, markets, temples, and churches.
It is the biggest city in the country.
How many people live in Suriname?
About 600,000 people live in Suriname.
It is one of the smallest countries in South America by population.
Most people live in Paramaribo and along the coast.
What language do people speak in Suriname?
The official language is Dutch, but many people also speak.
Sranentongo, a local Creole language, Hindi, Javanese, and Portuguese.
Creole English, especially in tourism.
Suriname is a multilingual country with many cultures.
What is the weather like in Suriname?
Suriname has a tropical climate.
It is hot and humid all year.
There are two rainy seasons and two dry seasons.
The temperature is around 27 to 32 degrees Celsius.
It often rains in the afternoon, especially in the jungle.
What does Suriname look like?
Suriname has words that cover most of the country, rivers like the Suriname River and Merawen River, mountains in the South, villages, farms, and wild nature.
The South is remote and many people travel by boat or small plane.
What animals live in Suriname?
Suriname is full of wildlife, monkeys, jaguars, and anteaters, parrots, toucans, and eagles, snakes, frogs, and lizards, turtles, manatees, and fish.
Suriname is one of the most biodiverse countries in the world.
What do people eat in Suriname?
Suriname's food is rich, spicy, and full of flavor.
It mixes food from India, Indonesia, Africa, China, and Europe.

People eat rice, noodles, and roti, chicken, fish, and shrimp, vegetables, lentils, and spices, popular dishes, palm baked root with chicken, roti with curry, Indian style flatbread with potato and chicken, muxialisi, rice with mixed meat or fish, bami, Javanese style noodles.
What do people drink in Suriname?
People drink water and fruit juice, lemonade and ginger drinks, coffee and tea, adults may drink beer or local rum.
Tropical fruits like mango, passion fruit, and soursop are popular.
What is life like in Suriname?
Life in Suriname is relaxed, friendly, and colorful.
People enjoy spending time with family and neighbors, cooking and eating together, celebrating festivals, dancing, singing and playing music, enjoying nature, rivers and forests.
What are some holidays and traditions?

Independence Day, November 25th, Holy Fagwa Hindu Spring Festival with colors, Eid celebrated by the Muslim community, Christmas with lights, music and food, maroon and indigenous celebrations with drums and dance.
Suriname respects many religions and cultures.
Some fun facts about Suriname.
Suriname is the only Dutch speaking country in South America.
Over 90 % of the land is rainforest.
People of many origins live together peacefully.
The flag is green, white, red with a gold star.
The country has no McDonald's, but it has lots of local food stands.
Now you know many things about Suriname.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the forests, languages and traditions.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emili.
See you next time.
Goodbye, or in Surinatongo, a bun.
